issue.title: Heartbeat thought-seed expansion invents fictional maintenance scripts/paths with no grounding
issue.symptom:
Found 2026-10-14 while investigating blueprint staleness (user asked about
updating/verifying blueprints "or have GAIA do that if she can" -- this is
the mechanism that would attempt it, and it's actively malfunctioning).

gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/heartbeat.py's ACT path
(_act_on_seed -> _expand_seed, ~line 475-550) takes a thought_seed's short
`seed` text + `context` dict and asks a separate LLM ("Lite", temperature
0.3, max_tokens 512) to expand it into "an actionable prompt" with ZERO
grounding against real filesystem/repo state -- whatever the LLM invents
becomes `user_input` fed straight into `agent_core.run_turn()` under
session_id=HEARTBEAT_SESSION_ID ("gaia_heartbeat_session"), indistinguishable
from a real user message.

Live repro, same session window as the GAIA_Project-e8hf sleep-cycle
fabrication incident (2026-10-14 13:09-13:16 UTC, 7 consecutive journal
entries cognition-20261014-1309 through -1316, tags
session:gaia_heartbeat_session): a seed about stale documentation
(presumably planted by the real docs_maintenance sleep task, which DOES
exist and legitimately writes to /shared/docs_drafts/) got expanded, turn
over turn, into increasingly elaborate fictional tooling:
- "cd /gaia/maintenance && python3 /gaia/scripts/docs_maintenance.py" --
  neither /gaia/maintenance nor /gaia/scripts/docs_maintenance.py exist
  (confirmed via docker exec ls, both "No such file or directory").
- "python3 -m gaia_maintenance.service" -- no such package.
- "cd /shared/docs_drafts && ./run_incidents_list.sh" and
  "run_draft_list.sh" repeated 7 times in one invented command list --
  no such scripts exist in /shared/docs_drafts (real contents: just
  AS_BUILT_LATEST.md and one June docs_draft_*.json).
- "git status" inside /shared/docs_drafts -- not a git repo.
- Checking for "outstanding pull requests or merge conflicts" -- not
  applicable to this directory/task at all.
- Final turn in the chain actually tried `file read
  /shared/docs_drafts/AS_BUILT_ARCHITECTURE.md` -- also doesn't exist
  (real file is AS_BUILT_LATEST.md).

No actual damage occurred: every shell command either targeted a
nonexistent path (would fail immediately) or was sitting behind an
unapproved-tool-call gate ("I need your approval before I start" --
several of the batches were 25-100+ invented commands). But this is the
same root confabulation pattern as e8hf (ungrounded LLM narrative
generation shipping as if factual), now surfacing in the AUTONOMOUS
TASK-EXECUTION pipeline rather than chat -- a higher-stakes blast radius
category since the model is actively trying to invoke shell/file tool
calls based on its own fabrications, not just saying something wrong to a
human who can push back.

DESIGN (not investigated further tonight): _expand_seed's system prompt
(_EXPAND_SYSTEM_PROMPT) should probably require the expansion to only
reference paths/tools it can verify exist (give it a real directory
listing of relevant real paths as grounding context, e.g. the actual
contents of /shared/docs_drafts/ when the seed is about docs), or the ACT
path should skip the free-text "expand into a prompt" step entirely for
doc-maintenance-type seeds and call the real docs_maintenance task
directly instead of asking a model to reinvent it. Worth checking whether
other seed types (not just doc-maintenance) hit this same ungrounded-
expansion issue -- this repro happened to be about docs because that's
what the Architect was asking about, not necessarily because doc-seeds are
uniquely affected.

Related: GAIA_Project-e8hf (same root cause, different subsystem — chat
response confabulation vs. autonomous task confabulation. Keep these
separate since remediation likely differs: e8hf's fix path is about
post-hoc audit/correction, this one is about pre-generation grounding of
an internal planning step that never reaches a human to catch it).

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_seed_expansion_grounding_duzp.py
"""duzp: a thought seed's expansion runs as a real turn. 2026-10-14 a seed
about stale docs expanded into invented tooling the turns then tried to run.
An expansion naming a path or identifier the seed didn't give is dropped."""
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from gaia_core.cognition.reflection_grounding import ungrounded_paths

SEED = {"seed": "The architecture docs in /shared/docs_drafts look stale; AS_BUILT_LATEST.md is from June.",
        "context": {"source": "docs_maintenance"}}

INVENTED = ("Run cd /gaia/maintenance && python3 /gaia/scripts/docs_maintenance.py, then "
            "cd /shared/docs_drafts && ./run_incidents_list.sh and python3 -m gaia_maintenance.service.")

GROUNDED = ("Read /shared/docs_drafts/AS_BUILT_LATEST.md and compare it with what you know of "
            "the current architecture. List the sections that look out of date.")


def _hb(reply):
    from gaia_core.cognition.heartbeat import ThoughtSeedHeartbeat
    hb = ThoughtSeedHeartbeat.__new__(ThoughtSeedHeartbeat)
    llm = MagicMock()
    llm.create_chat_completion.return_value = {"choices": [{"message": {"content": reply}}]}
    return hb, llm


def test_paths_caught_unless_given_or_on_disk():
    on_disk = {"/shared/docs_drafts"}
    found = ungrounded_paths(INVENTED, str(SEED), exists=lambda p: p in on_disk)
    assert "/gaia/maintenance" in found and "/gaia/scripts/docs_maintenance.py" in found
    assert "./run_incidents_list.sh" in found
    assert "/shared/docs_drafts" not in found
    # a real file the seed didn't spell out passes because it exists ...
    assert ungrounded_paths(GROUNDED, str(SEED), exists=lambda p: True) == []
    # ... and is caught when it doesn't
    assert ungrounded_paths(GROUNDED, str(SEED), exists=lambda p: False) == [
        "/shared/docs_drafts/AS_BUILT_LATEST.md"]


def test_invented_expansion_is_dropped():
    hb, llm = _hb(INVENTED)
    assert hb._expand_seed(llm, SEED) == ""


def test_grounded_expansion_passes(monkeypatch):
    import os
    real = os.path.exists
    monkeypatch.setattr(os.path, "exists",
                        lambda p: p == "/shared/docs_drafts/AS_BUILT_LATEST.md" or real(p))
    hb, llm = _hb(GROUNDED)
    assert hb._expand_seed(llm, SEED) == GROUNDED


def test_expansion_without_paths_passes():
    hb, llm = _hb("Reflect on whether the architecture documentation still matches how you work today.")
    assert hb._expand_seed(llm, SEED).startswith("Reflect on")

+# A file path: absolute, ./relative or ../relative, or a bare name with a
+# script/file extension ("run_incidents_list.sh").
+_PATH = re.compile(
+    r"(?<![\w/.])(?:\.{1,2})?/[\w.\-]+(?:/[\w.\-]+)*"
+    r"|(?<![\w/.])[\w\-]+\.(?:sh|py|md|json|ya?ml|txt|toml|cfg|ini|log)\b"
+)
+
+
+def ungrounded_paths(text: str, context: str, exists=None) -> List[str]:
+    """File paths in ``text`` that appear neither in ``context`` nor on disk
+    (duzp: a seed expansion ran 'cd /gaia/maintenance && python3
+    /gaia/scripts/docs_maintenance.py'; neither exists)."""
+    import os
+    exists = exists or os.path.exists
+    ctx = (context or "")
+    found: List[str] = []
+    for m in _PATH.finditer(text or ""):
+        path = m.group(0).rstrip(".,;:")
+        if len(path) < 3 or path in ctx:
+            continue
+        if path.startswith("/") and exists(path):
+            continue
+        found.append(path)
+    return found
